detections.evidence_quote: Four of them died. One survived, even though his throat had been cut.
detections.summary: Narrator describes a 1983 home invasion in which four people died and one survived a cut throat.

detections.evidence_quote: Here, screwdrivers punctured my back, my lung, broke three ribs.
detections.summary: The survivor lists his injuries: slashed throat, stab and axe wounds, a punctured lung and three broken ribs.

detections.evidence_quote: also lost his life, all stabbed and slashed to death.
detections.summary: Narrator recounts that four victims were stabbed and slashed to death and an eight-year-old boy survived.

detections.evidence_quote: You lose somebody, and it's it hurts.
detections.summary: Victim's relative describes how losing family members changes your life and hurts.

detections.evidence_quote: according to the coroner, the victims had some 140 wounds.
detections.summary: Narrator reports the coroner counted some 140 wounds on the victims from multiple weapons.

detections.evidence_quote: Where were you hurt? My ear, my back, my neck, and that's it.
detections.summary: The wounded boy, unable to speak in hospital, signals three attackers and later names his ear, back and neck injuries.
